purpose: Discriminate four frozen single/mixed bottleneck theories with orthogonalized information, access/representation and compute interventions.

candidate_hypotheses.meaning: missing task-relevant information is the decisive bottleneck
information is present but access/representation is the decisive bottleneck
information and access are adequate but search/inference compute is the decisive bottleneck
all three factors are jointly necessary; no proper subset repairs the bottleneck
candidate_hypotheses.predicted_repair_rule: repair iff intervention contains all three factors

full_factorial_role: estimate interactions and audit intervention purity; not required by the deterministic four-hypothesis separation theorem

purity_requirements.J_I: hold representation/access implementation and compute budget fixed; record exact added information bytes/tokens/features
purity_requirements.J_A: preserve task information and compute budget while changing only the information interface/representation as far as operationally possible
purity_requirements.J_C: preserve information and representation while changing only search/inference budget as far as operationally possible
purity_requirements.factorial_cells: record all factor deltas; any unavoidable cross-factor change becomes a named protocol deviation

matched_resource_requirements: same task instances within a family
family is the primary inference unit
retain null, adverse and CANNOT_CHECK families
anti_leakage: freeze hypothesis response signatures before evaluation outcomes
freeze intervention implementations before evaluation outcomes
no domain deletion after outcome access
no threshold retuning after outcome access
no relabeling a failed mechanism as a new successful one under the same identity
historical_evidence_policy: Historical favorable, null, scaling-negative and CANNOT_CHECK results may motivate the hypothesis family but cannot count as prospective outcomes for this successor identity.
